source:
@@U03961@@
Never let loose of this dress! Never! Demons already are plucking away at its edges, eager to drag it off to the underworld. Hold fast to it, I say! This may no longer be the goddess you've lost, but it is divine. Make the most of this favor beyond all price and raise yourself up with it. It will bear you swiftly above all things common into vast Spaces as long as you survive. We'll meet again, we two, far, very far from here. (海伦'S clothes dissolve into clouds, surround 浮士德, bear him aloft, and move off with him. 福耳库阿斯 picks up 欧福里翁 5 robe, cloak, and lyre and advances into the proscenium, holds them up, and speaks.)
translation:
@@U03961@@
永远不要松开这件衣服！绝不！恶魔们已经开始撕扯它的边缘，渴望将它拖入地下世界。我说，坚持住！这可能不再是你失去的女神，但它是神圣的。充分利用这份不计代价的恩惠，并以此提升自己。只要你还活着，它就会带着你飞快地飞过所有常见的东西进入广阔的空间。我们两个，会再次见面的，距离这里很远很远。 （海伦衣裳化云，围浮士德，高举而行。福耳库阿斯，拿起欧福里翁五袍、斗篷、琴，上台上，举起而行。）
